newsitem.title: UK: NatWest would buy if good for shareholders.
newsitem.headline: NatWest would buy if good for shareholders.

text.p: National Westminster Bank Plc's chief Derek Wanless on Monday refused to rule out the British bank buying other firms if such a move improved shareholder value.
"We are looking at whether we think there is value to be created for shareholders, whether it's in investment banking or in consolidation of any part of the business," Wanless told Reuters.
He said the British banking giant had not said anything publicly about reports it had approached Abbey National Plc about a possible merger.
